summary: Lilly's retatrutide showed benefits beyond weight loss, cutting sleep apnea severity by up to 60.6% in Phase 3.
Novo's lower-dose CagriSema produced about 21% weight loss, ahead of an FDA decision expected in Q4 2026.
Amylin combinations are the new battleground; Lilly's EloraTZP reached up to 23.3% weight loss in Phase 2.
Access is the bottleneck: more than one in three first insurance requests for GLP-1 drugs were denied.

items.title: TRIUMPH-1, TRIUMPH-2, TRIUMPH-4 trials, retatrutide (Eli Lilly)
lines: TRIUMPH-1: apnea-hypopnea index (AHI, breathing pauses per hour) fell up to 36.1 events/hour (60.6%) at 80 weeks; CI, p-value and n not reported.
TRIUMPH-2, patients who also have type 2 diabetes: AHI fell up to 28.4 events/hour (48.1%) at 80 weeks; CI and n not reported.
Knee osteoarthritis pain on the WOMAC (Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index) scale: down up to 4.3 points (73.1%) at 80 weeks in TRIUMPH-1.
TRIUMPH-4: WOMAC pain down up to 4.5 points (75.8%) at 68 weeks; retatrutide is a GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon triple agonist, still investigational.

items.title: REDEFINE 9 and REDEFINE 1 analyses, CagriSema (Novo Nordisk)
lines: REDEFINE 9 (Phase 3b): lower doses of 1.7mg/1.7mg and 1.0mg/1.0mg gave about 21% average weight loss; CI and n not reported; published in Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology.
REDEFINE 1 post hoc analysis: 67.8% of patients on CagriSema 2.4mg/2.4mg were early responders and lost 25% of body weight on average (n=2,108 CagriSema vs 705 placebo).
Bone substudy (n=252; 154 CagriSema, 55 placebo): bone density fell but stayed in the normal range; size of the change not reported.
FDA application filed December 2025; decision expected Q4 2026.

items.title: Phase 2 trial, EloraTZP (eloralintide plus tirzepatide) and eloralintide (Eli Lilly)
lines: Weight loss up to 23.3% (54.1 lbs) at 48 weeks from a 232.4 lb baseline, in obesity or overweight with type 2 diabetes; CI and n not reported.
A1C (average blood sugar) fell by up to 2.9 percentage points; up to 77% reached normal blood sugar; up to 60% no longer met the BMI cutoff for obesity.
Eloralintide exit interviews: 74% reported fewer cravings, 52% less food noise; 41% of baseline drinkers drank less alcohol.

items.title: SURMOUNT-ADOLESCENTS trial, Zepbound (tirzepatide) (Eli Lilly)
lines: Body mass index (BMI) fell 21.4% on average at 72 weeks in ages 12 to under 18; CI, p-value and n not reported.
More than half of adolescents no longer met the BMI criteria for obesity at 72 weeks; presented as a late-breaker on November 15, 2026.

items.title: Oral GLP-1 pills in real-world use, Foundayo (orforglipron) (Eli Lilly) and Wegovy pill (Novo Nordisk)
lines: FOUNDERS survey: 96-98% of Foundayo users said the daily pill was simple and easy; about 40% took it in the afternoon, evening or at bedtime; n not reported.
Novo presented 26 abstracts, including ORACLE, a cost comparison of oral semaglutide vs orforglipron; figures not reported.

items.title: Insurance access and payer evidence for GLP-1 drugs (AJMC coverage of late-breaking abstracts)
lines: More than 1 in 3 first prior-authorization (insurer pre-approval) requests for on-label GLP-1 weight-loss drugs denied, commercially insured adults aged 18-63, January-September 2025.
Persistence vs downstream spending study: 27,013 adults starting semaglutide or tirzepatide injections, Optum data 2020-2025; savings figures not reported.

items.title: Rare-disease and early-stage drugs: setmelanotide (Rhythm), WVE-007 (Wave Life Sciences), IBIO-610 (iBio), SYNT-101 (Syntis Bio, private)
lines: Rhythm TRANSCEND Phase 3, two-year data: continuous setmelanotide kept BMI down in acquired hypothalamic obesity; figures not reported; 17-expert panel proposed diagnostic criteria.
Wave WVE-007 (RNA drug targeting the INHBE gene): interim Phase 1 INLIGHT data shown; figures not reported.
iBio IBIO-610 (Activin E antibody): 2.3% weight reduction vs control at week 28 in obese monkeys.
Syntis SYNT-101 late-breaker: meal-triggered PYY up 5.1-fold, GLP-1 up 2.3-fold, ghrelin down 37%; zero discontinuations among 55 dosed people.

expert_minds: Pipeline beyond GLP-1 drugs (EloraTZP, CagriSema, retatrutide, amylin, RNA approaches) is diversifying fast, per the ConscienHealth wrap-up.
Health systems are ill-equipped to deliver the better treatments now available, per ConscienHealth; AJMC's denial data back this up.
Amylin is the next hot target and Lilly and Novo face off there, per BioSpace citing BMO's Evan Seigerman.
Focus is moving past the scale to fat vs muscle, organ outcomes and quality of life, per BioSpace and Lilly's Kenneth Custer.

brief.caveat: Company releases gave 'up to' averages without CIs, p-values or n; I could not open the full REDEFINE 9 release or find stock reactions; the comparison with 2025 rests on a few wrap-ups.
